decisions.reason: The Hero V state already identifies the attached Option 2 as the unchanged approved geometry rather than the revised presentation form; message 122 confirms that existing state without changing it.
The accent already requires literal extraction of the terminal section from the approved Hero V and exact correspondence with that gesture; message 122 restates this established requirement.
The source concerns alignment of the Hero V, lowercase v, and É accent before complete-wordmark work; it does not change the deferred E and L letterform requirements.
Placing the three V-system forms together for verification does not change the deferred wordmark kerning or rhythm requirements.
The selection and derivation of the V-system geometry do not alter the deferred champagne-gold material direction or its application constraint.
The source provides design corrections and requests a comparison presentation but does not change the requirement to include rationale with each design round.
The attached Option 2 reference is incidental to the source decision; no review-image format or accessibility requirement is changed.
